scenarios.name: Reopen customization after choosing a command source without editing

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
the Part | Tools custom target is empty
the user opens Customize from Tools
the user selects "View Tab" as the command source
the available command list shows View Tab commands
the user closes customization without editing any commands
the user opens Customize from Tools again
the Part | Tools custom target remains empty
